src/app/api/admin/email-test/route.ts.reason: The admin's explicit test mail to an address they typed — a transport check, not a notification.

src/app/api/admin/notification-templates.reason: Template preview sent to the admin themselves under the `test` category — a rendering check, not a notification.

src/lib/jobs/dlqAlert.ts.reason: Operator alert to ALERT_EMAIL_TO — an address from the server env, not a person with a User row, preferences or a catalogue event.

src/lib/mailOpsAlert.ts.reason: Operator alert to ALERT_EMAIL_TO — an address from the server env, not a person with a User row, preferences or a catalogue event.

src/lib/newsletterDispatch.ts.reason: Newsletter dispatch is a separate bulk product with its own consent model, NewsletterSend ledger and List-Unsubscribe pair (docs/newsletter.md) — deliberately not routed (#1711).

src/lib/notify.ts.reason: The in-app transport itself: adapters/inApp.ts delivers through notify(), so its one bell-row write is the channel, not a bypass.

src/lib/rosterAlert.ts.reason: Roster-feed failure alert to ALERT_EMAIL_TO and the tenant supportEmail — configured addresses, not User rows; no catalogue event applies.

src/lib/securityNotices.ts.reason: Security notices send their mail inline under the essential account_security category: the notice needs the device, local time and "not you?" block the event template cannot carry (docs/security-notices.md). The in-app half already goes through notifyEvent().
